description: A man in a bicorne hat and dark frock coat grips a tall staff bearing a flag of vertical blue, white and red bands, shouting amid a crowd of raised fists. The crowd wears red knit caps and some carry muskets with bayonets. The setting is a dim, columned hall with balconies and smoke, painted in an oil-painting style. There is a small roundel cockade on the hat and no visible letters or frame.
